patterns.statement: Epic provides a comprehensive UI material library in the engine — check it first before authoring new UI materials
patterns.condition: Before building a HUD or UI material from scratch
patterns.action: Check the FNE_UI Systems folder for existing material collections and create an instance rather than building one

patterns.statement: Choose the parent material by the widget's display purpose, not by generic properties
patterns.condition: When creating a UI widget material
patterns.action: Select the parent material by widget type: rectangles use M_UI_Rectangle, bars use M_UI_LinearMeter, rings use M_UI_RadialMeter, icons use M_UI_SDFTexture, clipped images use M_UI_TextureMask

patterns.statement: All Epic meter materials share a common parameter interface — drive them with one Verse call per widget and keep visual customization on the instance
patterns.condition: When driving a meter widget from Verse code
patterns.action: Call a single Verse update per widget targeting shared parameters: Progress, ProgressRangeMin/Max, ProgressIsNormalized, FillDirection, Snapping; keep color and shape on the material instance

patterns.statement: Organize material instances by family with consistent naming and a showcase widget per family
patterns.condition: When creating a set of UI materials for the same widget family
patterns.action: Name instances as MI_UI_FamilyName_NN, store each family in its own folder, create a UW_FamilyName showcase widget, and do not duplicate the Epic collection folder

patterns.statement: SDF textures with stroke/shadow/glow parameters scale better than pre-baked icon sets
patterns.condition: When choosing between baked icon textures and parameterized icon rendering for the HUD
patterns.action: Use a single SDF texture with configurable stroke, shadow, and glow parameters instead of maintaining multiple pre-baked icon textures
